tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal mahā mā ya'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rin chen

sgron me zhes bya ba bzhugs/ 'di dang po rngog pa'i lugs zangs ma sbyar ba las/ rngog lugs la dgyes rdor dang 'dres pa sogs ci rigs 'dug pas skyon de rnams spangs te/ phyis rang gzhung dang bstun pa'i gtsang ngag tu byas pa'o/ / oṃ swā sti/ sku gsum ye shes lnga yi bdag /sgyu 'phrul chen mo la btud nas/ / dkyil 'khor cho ga'i rim pa ni/ /mdo tsam rab tu gsal bar bya/ /mahā ma ya'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga lag tu blang ba la/ slob dpon dang slob ma'i mtshan nyid dang*/ bsnyen pa ji ltar bya ba'i tshul rnams spyi dang mthun no/ / 'dir dkyil 'khor gyi las dang*/ slob ma dbang bskur ba dang*/ rjes dkyil 'khor nyer bsdu ste gsum las/ dad po la sa chog dang*/ sta gon dang*/ dkyil 'khor zhag gi cho ga ste gsum mo/ /dang po la drug las/ dang po sa brtag pa ni spyi dang mthun/ gnyis pa bslang ba la gsum las/ 'jig rten 'das pa'i lha la bslang ba ni/ dkyil 'khor bya ba'i sa gzhir rnam lnga dang*/ dri bzang gis byugs/ mchod pa lnga dang*/ gtor ma gsum bsham/ rdo rje dril bu nang mchod rnams 'dus byas la/ oṃ a mṛ ta kun+ḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ kyis bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ mdun gyi tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang nas/ sgyu 'phrul chen mo lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa ni/ pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ lte ba la dpal he ru ka sngon po= zhes pa nas/ dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /shar du rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo= zhes pa nas/ ḍā ma ru bsnams pa'o/ / de nas/ lha mo lnga ni= zhes pa nas/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ zhes pa'i bar dang*/ dbang gi lha= zhes pa nas/ don grub kyi dbu brgyan/ zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin brjod/ mchod pa/ swa bha wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i ka pā la'i nang du hūṃ las byung ba'i me tog bdug spos/ mar me dri chab zhal zas dang gzhan yang mchod rdzas rnam pa du ma rnams ye shes kyi rang bzhin nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/

oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ de bzhin du/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ ni wi t+ya/ rnams la yang sbyar/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las mchod pa'i lha mo spros/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la mchod par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pratīts+tsha swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ zhes sogs kyi mchod/ de nyid lnga pas bstod/ sgrub thabs ltar gtor ma bsangs sbyangs nas brtsams/ bā liṃ ta ha ho phaṭa/ ces pa yan chad kyis gtor ma phul/ /spos dang bcas pa'i rdor dril 'dzin pas/ bde gshegs thams cad bdag la dgongs/ khyed rnams mchod pa'i phyir dang ni/ /slob ma rnams la phan gdags phyir/ /sgyu 'phrul chen mo zhes bya ba'i/ /dkyil 'khor bzang po bri bar 'tshal/ /bdag la byin rlabs gnang bar mdzod/ / ces lan gsum brjod cing gnang ba thob par bsam/ sa'i lha mo la bslang ba ni/ lag pa g.yas pa sa la lan gsum du gdab/ sa 'og nas byon pa'i sa'i lha mo gser gyi mdog can/ phyag gnyis dbang por khas len pa'i phyag rgya dang gser gyi bum pa can/ lte ba yan chad sa las thon nas/ bdag gi bgyi zhes gsung bzhin par gyur/ mchod yon sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod kyis gong bzhin mchod/ oṃ āḥhūṃ gis gtor ma gnyis pa byin gyi rlabs/ a kā ro lan gsum gyis phul/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ / zhes sogs lan gsum gyi gsol ba btab/ /lha mo des kyang*/ khyod ni slob dpon mchog yin gyi/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni las kyis shigaces gsungs nas sa la thim par gyur/ gnas kyi bdag po las sa bslang pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūṃ gis gtor ma gsum pa byin gyis rlabs/ a kā ro= lan bdun la sogs pa'i gtor ma phul/ dril bu dkrol zhing*/ sa phyogs 'dir ni lha dang klu/ /gnod sbyin dri za lha ma yin/ /gang dag rdzu 'phrul che ldan pa/ /rdo rje'i spyan dang snyan mnga' ba/ /thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bya ba yis/

/bde gshegs rnams la mchod pa dang*/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /dge ba'i sa phyogs 'di nyid du/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa cher 'byung ba/ /sgyu 'phrul chen mo rgyud kyi rgyal/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i las byed pas/ khyod kyis bar chad ma byed par/ /dge ba'i grogs po nyid du mdzod/ / ces lan gsum brjod/ gsum pa sa sbyang ba la/ dang po drag po dang*/ zhi ba'i spyin bsreg gis sbyang ba yin/ gnyis pa las dang bya bas sbyang ba spyi dang mthun/ gsum pa rdzas sngags kyis sbyang ba ni/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha ni hūṃ/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūṃ/ gṛh+ṇa pā ya gṛh+ṇa pā ya hūṃ/ ā na ya ho bha ga wān bid+yā rā dza hūṃ phaṭa/ ces lan mdun bzla zhing dri chab gtor ro/ /bzhi pa bsrung ba ni/ hūṃ khaṃ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ laṃ yongs su gyur pa las gser gyi sa gzhi'i dbus su hūṃ las byung ba'i sna tshogs rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros pas rdo rje sa gzhi dang rwa gur du gyur/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes lan gsum brjod/ lnga pa ting nge 'dzin gyis sa bzung ba ni/ bla ma dag pa'i cho ga nas brtsams te bzlas pa'i bar du rdzogs par nyams su blang*/ sngags rnams kyang brgya rtsa re tsam bzla bar bya'o/ /drug pa bgegs sbyang ba ni/ las kyi slob dpon yod na/ des gsol btab kyi bya ba byed pa yin la/ med na slob ma gang yang rung ba bzhis dus gcig tu gsol ba gdab/ de yang med na slob ma gcig nyid kyis phyogs bzhi nas rim pas byas kyang rung ste/ gang ltar yang slob dpon gyi phyogs bzhir mchod pa rnam lngar bshams/ gong ltar mchod pa byin gyis brlabs la 'bul/ gzhung las/ rang bzhin rnam dag sogs kyis bstod par bshad kyang*/ de bod na med pas de'i tshab tu/ rnam dag chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*/ /thabs kyi sprul pa sna tshogs ston mdzad pa'i/ /gdug pa 'dul phyir 'jigs pa'i skur ston pa/

khro bo'i rgyal po he ru ka dpal 'dud/ / ces bstod/ dkyil 'khor gtso bo kun gyi dngos/ /sdig pa thabs cad zad byed pa/ /sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /mgon po chen pos bshad du gsol/ / des lan gsum gsol ba btab/ de nas/ bdag nyid thugs rje'i spyan gyis 'gro ba mtha' dag la gzigs te/ /thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis lha mo bzhi po yongs su drangs te/ rang gi zhal bzhi la thim/ gzhal med khang bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa yang rang gi snying gar thim/ rang gi mig g.yas par ma las nyi ma/ /g.yon par ṭa las zla ba/ mig 'bras hūṃ las rdo rje 'bar ba/ rkang mthil gnyis su a las byung ba'i rdo rje rgya gram gnyis su gyur/ hūṃ ring po lan mang du brjod/ khro bo'i tshogs kyis bgegs bskrad/ rdo rje rgya gram dang brkyang ba'i 'od zer gyis sa gzhi dang rwa gur du gyur/ dbus nas dbang ldan gyi mtshams su 'gying bag dang bcas rdo rje dril bu thogs te/ hūṃ song shig bgegs tshogs ma lus kun/ /lha dang lha min gsang ba pa/ /bgegs kyi tshogs chen ma lus kun/ /gnod par byed pa'i bgegs tshogs rnams/ /sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i bdag nyid gtso/ /bde chen ye shes las byung ba/ /nga ni dpal ldan rdo rje dngos/ /bka' yi 'khor lo rab sbyor byed/ /gal te nga las 'das gyur na/ /rdo rje rab tu 'bar ba yis/ /mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas shing*/ /zhi bar 'gyur ba gdon mi za/ /de bas gzhan du 'gro bar gyis/ /oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ song shig= ces pa man chad lan gsum brjod/ cung zad spros pa la dga' na hūṃ hūṃ zhes glur len zhing*/ stang stabs rnams skabs 'dir bya/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān ban+dha hūṃ phaṭa/ kyis phur bu byin gyis rlabs/ oṃ gha gh= sogs dang*/ oṃ badz+ra murga ra= sogs kyis phur gdab bya/ bsdu na hūṃ zhes bskor ba lan gsum mam gcig gis kyang rung ngo*/

/gnyis pa sta gon la/ lha lhag gnas/ bum pa lhag gnas/ slob ma lhag gnas te gsum las/ dang po ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi dri bzang gis zlum por byugs/ dri bzang gi thig le lnga tshom gyi steng du me tog gi tshom bu bkod/ mchod pa sna lnga mchod yon dang bcas pa bsham/ rnal 'byor gyi yo byad rnams tshogs pa byas te/ gong du bshad pa ltar gnas kyis bdag po'i gtor mas/ sngon 'gro gtor ma btang*/ gnas yo byin rlabs spyi dang mthun pa'am/ gong bzhin mchod pa byin rlabs byas nas/ bla ma dag pa nas bzlas pa'i bar gyi bdag bskyed bya/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las tshom bu'i gnas su he ru ka lha lnga yongs su rdzogs pa ni/ dbus su oṃ āḥhrīḥhūṃ hūṃ oṃ bud+dha ḍā ki nī āḥhrīḥhūṃ hūṃ yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal he ru ka sngon po= nas dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /shar du oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī āḥhrīḥhūṃ las/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma= nas/ thod pa bsnams pa= lhor oṃ rat+na ḍā ki nī āḥhrīḥ hūṃ las rin chen mkha' 'gro ma/ nas/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa/ nub tu oṃ pad+ma ḍā ki nī āḥhrīḥhūṃ las pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma= nas/ mda' bsnams pa/ byang du oṃ bi shwaḍā ki nī āḥhrīḥhūṃ las sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ma= nas/ ḍā ma ru bsnams pa'o/ /lha mo lnga ni= zhes pa nas/ 'dzin pa'o/ /rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis ye shes kyi 'khor lo mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ mchod yon dang nyer spyod lngas mchod/ mche ba gtsigs shing*/ nas/ phyag 'tshal bstod/ ṭak+ki hūṃ dzaḥ ṭak+ki hūṃ hūṃ/ ṭak+ki hūṃ baṃ/ ṭak+ki hūṃ hoḥ zhes pas bsres/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od kyi dbang gi lha sangs rgyas byang sems= zhes pa nas/ don grub kyis dbu rgyan/ gong ltar mchod pa byin gyis rlabs la/ oṃ shrī he ru ka pañtsa ḍā ki nī ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ā hūṃ/ de bzhin du

pad+yaṃ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ lha so so'i sngags kyi mthar 'bru gsum btags pas nang mchod/ mkha' 'gro lnga dpag tu med pa sprul te rjes su chags pas mnyes par bsam la/ hūṃ zhes brjod pas gsang ba'i mchod pa rnams bya/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ / zhes sogs kyis bstod/ spros pa la dga' na dngos gzhi'i mdun bskyed kyi skabs ltar mchod bstod rgyas pa byas kyang rung ngo*/ /de nas spos dang bcas pa'i rdor dril 'dzin pas/ / he ru ka dpal bcom ldan 'das/ /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma dang ldan/ /phyogs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang*/ /rig pa'i lha mo rdzu 'phrul can/ /byang chub sems dpa' la sogs kun/ /thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /slob ma rnams la phan phyir dang*/ khyed la yang ni mchod pa'i phyir/ /bdag gis sngags sdig 'jig byed pa'i/ /nangs par dkyil 'khor 'bri lags na/ /rjes su rtse bar dgongs nas ni/ /byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ / zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab pas snyan gsan dbab/ gnyis pa ni/ lha lnga'i bum pa la rigs lnga'i mtshan ma dang*/ las bum la rdo rje rgya gram 'bri/ gzhi dkar po'i steng du me tog bkram pa la lha'i rim pa 'god/ sum+bha 'i sngags bzla zhing gu gul bdug /yungs kar gyis brabs la bzhag /bum pa rnams bsangs sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las bh+ruṃ las rin po che'i bum pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ nang lha'i bzhugs gnas 'od zer 'phro ba dang bcas par gyur pa so so'i dbus su/ paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor re re/ de rnams kyi steng du hūṃ oṃ hūṃ swā āḥhā rnams kyi 'od kyi 'phro 'du las rdo rje dang mda' dang rdo rje dang rin po che dang pad+ma dang ral gri rnams hūṃ oṃ hūṃ swā āḥhā rnams kyi mtshan pa/ de rnams las sku phra mo dpag tu med pa 'phros/ sangs rgyas mchod sems can gyi don byas/

tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las dbus kyi bum par dpal he ru ka = sogs dang*/ shar gyi bum par rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma = sogs dang*/ lho'i bum par rin chen mkha' 'gro ma = sogs dang*/ nub kyi bum par pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma = sogs dang*/ byang gi bum par sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ma = sogs dang*/ lha mo lnga po ni = nas/ 'dzin pa'o 'i bar rnams lha sta gon gyis rigs 'gre/ snying ga'i hūṃ gi 'od kyis ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho/ lha sta gon gyi skabs ltar mchod bstod byas la/ bum pa'i steng du thod pa'am dung chos bdud rtsis gang ba bdud rtsi la reg pa tsam du rdo rje gzungs thag dpyangs/ gzungs thag kha rgyan la bcing*/ sne mo nas slob dpon gyis bzung ngo*/ /sngags kyi 'od zer gzungs thag la 'khril te bum par song bas lha lnga bum chu'i rdul phra rab kyi grangs dang mnyam pas bum pa gang bar gyur/ so sor sngags brgya rtsa re bzla'o/ /ka pā la'i bdud rtsi bum pa so sor blug /bum pa'i lha rnams zag pa med pa'i bde bas thugs rgyud tshim ste/ bdud rtsir zhu nas bum chu dang dbyer med du gyur/ las bum stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i bum pa mtshan nyid tshang ba'i nang du/ hūṃ las khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa sku mdog sngon po/ g.yas rdo rje g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ khro bo'i rgyan dang cha lugs rdzogs shing*/ pad nyi la g.yon brkyang stabs kyis me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od kyis khro bo ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ mchod pa lngas mchod/ gzungs thag gong bzhin bsham/ sngags kyi 'od zer gzungs thag la 'khril te bum par song bas/ khro chung bum chu'i rdul phra rab kyi grangs dang mnyam pas bum pa gang bar gyur/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ ces brgya tsam bzlas la/ 'jigs pa'i hūṃ sgra nges sgrog cing= zhes sogs kyi bstod/

rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob rnams kyis cho ga'i rim pa 'di ma thon gyi bar du bgegs bzlog pa dang*/ bar chad thams cad bsrung du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab la bzhag /mar rngog gi lugs la las bum gyi lha mi bzhu mod ci ltar skabs su bab pas rung ngo*/ /gsum pa ni slob ma'i bya ba yin yang dkyil 'khor gyi las kyi skabs 'dir 'brel che bas zhor la bstan pa ste/ slob ma rnams la sngon 'gro'i chos bshad bya/ des kyang maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ slob dpon gyis 'di skad ces brjod do/ / sngags kyi dngos grub don gnyer gang*/ /dkyil 'khor 'di ni gzhug par bya/ /bsod nams 'dod pas de las gzhan/ /gzhan ni 'jig rten pha rol gnyer/ /slar yang dad pa ldan pa dag /'jig rten pha rol la dmigs nas/ /blo ldan dkyil 'khor gzhug bya ste/ /'di yi 'bras bu gnyer mi bya/ /gal te 'di 'bras don gnyer na/ /'jig rten pha rol 'grub mi 'gyur/ /'jig rten pha rol la dmigs na/ /'bad pa med par 'di 'bras 'grub/ / ces brjod cing don bshad/ de nas gsol ba btab pa ni/

dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ / mgon po chen pos bdag 'jug mdzod/ / ces lan gsum du gsol ba gdab/ de nas/ slob dpon gyis slob ma de 'od kyi gong bur byas la/ rang gi zhal du zhugs/ a wa dhū tī nas yum gyi pad+mar babs/ he ru ka'i gzugs kyis phyir spros pa la/ sngags kyi theg par blo dgug pa ni/ bu tshur theg pa chen po la/ khyod ni tshul chen snod yin kyi/ /gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga ni/ khyod la yang dag bstan par bya/ / dus gsum 'byung ba'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can/ / mnyam nyid ye shes thob pa ni/ /rdo rje rab sngags sgom pas so/ /gsang sngags sbyor ba mnyam med dang*/ /he ru ka dpal skyob pa yis/ /bdud sde shin tu mi bzad pa'i/ /dpung chen dag kyang de yis bcom/ /de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir/ /bu yi blo gros 'di gyis shig / ces pa'am 'gyur spyi dang mthun par brjod de/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas rnams kyang gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa la brten nas sangs rgyas pa yin pas 'di la mos pa dang gus pa rtse gcig tu gyis shig byas la spro ba bskyed do/ /de nas rna ba gtad par bskul ba ni/ rtog pa thams cad legs par bsdus nas ni/ /shin tu bsam pa bzang dang ldan pa'i nyon/ /rjed nges blo la bde bar gshegs pa sogs/ /yi dam mkha' 'gro rnams kyis byin mi rlob/ / ces brjod/ de nas slob ma'i rgyud yongs su dag pa'i don du lnga rnam par dag par byas te/ bdag gis sdig pa bgyis pa dang*/ /bgyid du stsal dang yi rang ba/ /sangs rgyas spyan sngar mchis nas su/

/ma lus so sor bshags par bgyi/ / zhes pas sdig pa bshags pa dang*/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ /rang rgyal dgra bcom 'gro rnams dang*/ /sgom dang bzlas brjod bsod nams kyi/ /tshogs la bdag ni yi rang ngo*/ / zhes pas rjes su yi rang ba dang*/ sgyu 'phrul gtso bo yab yum dang*/ /mkha' 'gro ma dang bcas pa dang*/ /gsang sngags theg pa bla med pa'i/ /chos mchog la yang skyabs su mchi/ / zhes pas skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ dus gsum bde gshegs thams cad dang*/ /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed pa ltar/ /de bzhin bdag gis sems bskyed do/ / zhes pas sems bskyed dang*/ bdag gi dge ba'i las rnams kyis/ /'jig rten myur du sangs rgyas shog / sems can 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las/ /bla med gnas su bsgral bar bgyi/ / zhes pas dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo zhing*/ dam bca' ba rnams lan gsum gsum rjes bzlos byed du bzhug go /de nas gsol ba gdab pa sngon du 'gro bas/ sdom pa bzung bar khas blangs pa ni/ / 'gro ba'i mgon po bdag la dgongs/ /ma lus phyogs bzhugs bde gshegs rnams/ /dus 'di nas bzung sangs rgyas par/ /bla med bdag la gzigs par mdzod/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub du ni nges mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ / sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ / sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i/ /sdom pa deng nas bzung bar bgyi/ /rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang*/ /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang bzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po yis/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin du lan drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba'i/ /pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa la/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i theg pa gsum/

/dam pa'i chos kyang ma lus bzung*/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*/ /dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*/ / sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /bdag gis brtan por bzung bar bgyi/ /gnyis su med pa'i tshangs spyod dang*/ /rang gi dam tshig bsrung bar bgyi/ /byang chub sems ni bla med pa/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas/ / sems can kun kyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag gis sdom pa ma lus bzung*/ /ma grol ba rnams grol bar bgyi/ /ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi/ /dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*/ /sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/ / ces rjes bzlos byed du gzhug go / slob ma rnams skad cig gis he ru kar gyur/ gnas gsum du dri bzang gi thig le bkod/ de nyid du 'bru gsum dang phyag mtshan gsum du bskyed/ mi bskyod snang mtha' rnam par snang mdzad rnams spyan drangs te bstim/ de la mchod pa lngas mchod/ dngos grub kyi ltas btags pa'i don du/ so shing*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ gis slob ma la gtad/ de'i rnam lnga'i maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du 'dor du gzhug pa spyi dang mthun/ de nas khyor chu/ oṃ hrīḥbi shud+dha dharma dhā tu sarba pā baṃ ni tsā s+ya shodha ya sarba bi kalpan a pa na ya hūṃ/ zhes bzlas te hub gsum 'thung du gzhug de nas ku sha 'bru gsum dang*/ dri bzang gi chus bsangs la/ sngas dang gtan stan gyi don du sbyin/ bar chad zhi ba'i don du bsrung skud la snying po lan bdun bzlas pa slob ma'i dpung par bcing ngo*/ / de nas zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos bshad pa ni/ 'jig rten khams ni ma lus par/ / thams cad mkhyen pa 'byung mi 'byung*/ /u dum wa ra'i me tog bzhin/ /rgya lam na ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo*/ /gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba/

/de bas kyang ni rnyed dka' ste/ /gang gis sems can mnyam med don/ /bla na med pa byed nus pa/ /gnyis med zab mo'i spyod tshul 'di/ /sems can sangs rgyas thob byed pa'o/ /dang po bskal pa grangs med nas/ /bsags pa'i sdig pa gang dang gang*/ /de kun zad par gyur pa ni/ /zab mo'i dkyil 'khor mthong bas so/ / zhes brjod de don bshad do/ /rmi lam brtag cing ngan na bsrung ba spyi dang 'dra/ de nas rjes kyi bya ba ni/ tshogs kyi bya ba yod na skabs 'dir bya zhing*/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha la sgrub thabs ltar gtor ma phul/ slob dpon yol ba'i nang du song nas/ mchod pa gsar du bsham/ gong ltar byin gyis brlabs nas 'bul ba dang*/ de nyid lnga pa'i bstod pa bya/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa= sogs kyis bzod par gsol lhag chad skang ba'i don du yig ge brgya ba ci rigs par bzlas/ bcom ldan 'das sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyis bdag dang slob ma sngon du 'gro ba'i sems can thams cad la bar chad zhi ba dang*/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ smon lam dang bkra shis ci rigs par brjod/ de nyid kyi nub mor mar me bdug spaus sogs mchod pa rgyun ma chad par bya'o/ / nang par nyi ma ma shar ba'i sngon du mchod pa gcig bsham/ rdo rje shugs kyi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ be gā kra ma hoḥ zhes pa'i sngags kyis sta gon kyi dkyil 'khor nam mkhar bteg gong bzhin mchod pa byin rlabs dang mchod bstod bya/ dpal sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i lha tshogs rnams do nub spyan ma drangs kyi bar du mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs la/ bdag cag slob mar bcas pa la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ ces brjod/gsum pa/ dkyil 'khor zhag gi cho ga la/ thig tshon gyi cho ga /dkyil 'khor brgyan pa/ dkyil 'khor sgrub pa/ bdag nyid 'jug pa ste bzhi las/

dang po ni thig skud chang bu lnga lnga tshom du bzhag /tshon sna lnga thod par blugs pa la rigs lnga'i sa bon so sor 'bri/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las mi bskyod pa sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ bh+ruṃ las rnam snang dkar po 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ aṃ las rin 'byung ser po nor bu dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ dz+riṃ las 'od dpag med dmar po pad+ma dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ khaṃ las don grub ljang khu ral gri dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang rang snang gi yum dang bcas par gyur/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od kyis rigs lnga ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho/ gnyis su med par gyur/ mchod yon sngon du 'gro ba'i me tog sogs kyis mchod de nyid lnga pa'am/ chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang= sogs kyis bstod/ rigs lnga 'od du zhu ste thig tshon du gyur/ de nas/ oṃ a no n+yaḥ.a nu ga ta sarba dharma pa ra spa ra a nu pra biṣ+ta sarba dharmaḥ.ar+yan+ta a nu pra biṣ+ta sarba dharmaḥ.oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes brjod cing thig skud bsgril/ de nyid bdud rtsi lnga'i chu la sbangs te/ dz+dzaḥdz+dzaḥ zhes brjod cing thig sna slob ma'i lag tu gtad/ slob mas kyang de skad brjod cing drangs/ /slob dpon nub dang lhor gnas la/ /slob ma shar dang byang phyogs su/ /'dug ste rnam gnyis tshangs thig gdab/ /slob dpon me dang rlung gnas te/ /slob ma dbang ldan bden bral du/ / 'dug la shar dang nub gdab bo/ /de nyid gnas dang slob ma ni/ /dbang ldan gnas pas byang gi thig /byin za srin por gnas pas lho/ /de nyid gnas dang bden bral dang*/ /slob ma rlung dang dbang ldan du/ /gnas pas mtshams kyi thig gdab bo/ /de dag gi tshe oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya su tra ma ti kra ma hūṃ/ zhes brjod cing*/ rdo rje dang bcas pa'i lag pas gnam thig tu gdab/ de nas/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ ye thig gi ye shes pa gshegs/

/ las thig gzhan yod na de dang med na ye thig de nyid kyis las thig mdzad/ cha chen nyi shur byas nas ni/ /g.yas g.yon dag tu bcu bcu ste/ /dang po lte ba gsum 'dab ma/ /ze'u 'bru rdor 'phreng de nang bskor/ /bzhi pa lha snam dag tu bya/ /lhag ma rta babs rnam bzhi lugs/ /spyi dang mtshungs so dgu pa la/ /dur khrod bcu pa phyed du bsgos/ /rwa ba dang ni me ri'i sa/ /zhes so/ /dbang ldan du phyi nas rim pa bzhin dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba'i re kha lnga 'khyid gang tsam du slob dpon kho nas bris te/ thod pas bkab/ de'i steng du rdo rje bzhag /me tog 'ga' lag tu bzung nas/ 'di ni chos dbyings rnam par dag /sems can khams ni rab dgrol byed/ /sgyu 'phrul zhes bya rgyal po che/ /tshon gyi las ni yang dag brtsam/ /zhes brjod cing me tog gtor/ de nas thams cad kyis ci 'dod du bri bar bya ste/ lte ba sngon po ze'u 'bru khra bo 'dab brgyad dmar po gong ris mdzes tshon/ gzhi dkar po la rdo rje sngon bo'i 'phreng ba/ lha snam phyogs mdog 'dod yon dmar/ pha gu ser dra phyed sngo sgo rta babs spyi dang mthun/ dur khrod gzhi nag po la mtshan ma dkar po/ rwa ba dkar po la rdo rje sngon po/ me ri kha dog sna tshogs pa'o/ /lha mtshan ni dbus kyi lte ba la thod pa dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /'dab ma la shar du rdo rje/ lhor rin po che/ nub tu pad+ma/ byang du ral gri/ mtshams bzhir bum thod/ lha snam la bkra shis bum pa brgyad rnams bri'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ khang pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan la/ gzhung las/ skabs 'dir bum pa bskor bar bshad/ mchod pa'i bye brag rnams ni bcu las mi nyung ba bsham pa dang*/ bsdu na gtor ma gnyis su bsham/ gzhan du na/ lha lnga dang*/ phyogs skyong dang*/ zhing skyong dang*/ gzhi bdag gi gtor ma ste brgyad bsham/ sgos kyi chos skyong sogs kyi gtor ma yod na'ang bsham mo/ / gsum pa ni slob dpon gyi mdun du mchod pa lnga dang*/

rdor dril cang te'u nang mchod bzed zhal mchod yon gyi snod sogs tshogs par byas/ hūṃ zhes brjod cing*/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa= sogs lan gsum gyis bsrung bar bya/ nang mchod gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ rdo rje'i rtses dkyil 'khor dang yo byad rnams la bsangs gtor bya zhing*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes lan mang du brjod/ sngon 'gro gtor ma dang*/ gnas yo byin rlabs bya/ lha mtshan rnams skad cig gis 'od kyi gong bur gyur/ de'i rkyen gyis rten gzhal yas khang brten pa lha dang bcas pa/ thabs shes rab kyi rang bzhin skad cig gis gsal bar gyur pa ni/ nyi ma'i dky-il 'khor gyi steng du sna tshogs rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang = zhes pa nas/ yongs su bskor ba'i/ zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin las/ e las zhes dang*/ yaṃ las/ raṃ las/ baṃ las/ laṃ las/ paṃ las/ hūṃ las/ bh+ruṃ las zhes pa rnams dor/ dbus su pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa/ da'i lte ba dang phyogs bzhir nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor re re/ mtshams kyi 'dab ma la bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba/ lha snam la bkra shis kyi bum pa brgyad dang bcas pa/ dbus kyi mtshan pa dpal he ru ka sngon po= nas/ dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /shar gyi 'dab ma'i mtshan pa rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma= nas/ thod pa bsnam pa/ lho'i 'dab ma'i mtshan ma rin chen mkha' 'gro= nas/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa/ nub kyi 'dab ma'i mtshan pad+ma= nas/ mda' bsnams pa/ byang gyi 'dab ma'i mtshan ma sna tshogs= nas/ ḍā ma ru bsnams pa/ lha mo lnga ni= nas/ 'dzin pa'o/ /rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i sta gon gyi lha rnams badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ mchod bstod pa zhig bya/ ṭak+ki hūṃ dzaḥ sogs sngags bzhis/ gnyis su med par bsres/ oṃ badz+ra pra be sha ya hūṃ/ bdag nyid dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su phyin par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ur+gha ṭa sa ma ya pra be sha ya hūṃ/ zhes phyag rgya dang bcas pa lan bzhis sgo phye/ bla ma dag pa=

nas/ brtsams te/ bzlas pa thun gcig bya ba yan chad mngon rtogs rdzogs par bsgom/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ lan bdun/ bdag bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor dang gzugs brnyan dkyil 'khor gnyis su med par thim/ gzhung las skabs 'dir bum pa dkyil 'khor la 'god par bshad do/ / gtso bo yab yum gyi se gol gyi sgra dang snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas byung ba'i 'od kyis ye shes kyi 'khor lo spyan drangs/ bdag gi zhal du zhugs/ rdo rje'i lam nas lha mo'i pad+mar spros/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor yum gyi mkha' nang nas phyir phyung*/ mdun gyi nam mkhar gnas par gyur/ hūṃ zhes bgegs bskrad/ bla ma dag pa'i skabs ltar mchod pas mchod/ de nyid lnga pas bstod/ ṭak+ki hūṃ dzaḥ sogs kyis dkyil 'khor la dgug gzhug bya/ snying ga'i 'od kyis dbang gi lha sangs rgyas byang sems= zhes pa nas/ dbu rgyan gyi bar/ dkyil 'khor la dbang bskur rgyas gdab bya/ mchod rdzas rnams la dmigs te/ hūṃ zhes bgegs bskrad/ yi ge 'bru gsum mang du brjod pas byin gyis brlabs/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba yi/

sogs kyi tshigs bcad dang sbyar te/ oṃ shrī he ru ka pañtsa ḍā ki nī ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha āḥhūṃ/ sogs kyis mchod yon sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod lnga rol mo dang bcas pa dang*/ kha dog dbyibs legs= sogs kyis 'dod yon lnga dang*/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la sogs kyis rgyal srid sna bdun dang*/ deng nas brtsams te rdzogs sangs rgyas/ / sogs kyis sgeg sogs brgyad rnams kyis mchod do/ /nang mchod ni/ gtor ma ltar byin gyis rlabs/ he ru ka dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /ku ku rī pa mtsho skyes rdo rje dang*/ /ṭom+bi pa dang til+li nā ro pa/ /zhi ba bzang po chos kyi blo gros dang*/ /chos kyi rdo rje zhe sdang rdo rje dang*/ / rngog ston kun dga' rngog ston gzi brjid grags/ /rin bzang chos rgyal pa dang don grub dpal/ /byang chub dpal bzang byang chub dpal grub dang*/ /bkra shis dpal grub blo gros dpal bzang dang*/ /grol mchog zhabs dang rje btsun lha dbang grags/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la mchod pa 'bul/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ de nas lha so so'i snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum btags te/ mtheb srin g.yon pas blangs la 'bul/ slar yang 'bru gsum lan brgyad kyis dur khrod gnas pa rnams la 'bul/ chos skyong dang gzhi bdag gi bar la 'bul bar spro na'ang bar 'dir 'bul lo/ /gsang ba'i mchod pa ni/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma'i mgo bor = zhes pa nas/ a wa dhu tī'i lam nas byang chub kyi sems kyi ngo bor gyur pa sku'i cha thams cad du khyab pas bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes sku nyams su bstar bar gyur/ / zhes so/ /de nas bstod pa ni/ mche ba gtsigs shing = sogs dang*/ de nyid lnga pa dang*/ grub thob ku ku rī pa nyid kyis mdzad pa'i bstod pa 'dis kyang bstod de/ / dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor lor bsgyur/ /ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid/

/'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /kun tu rtog pa'i 'ching gcod cing*/ /'jig rten bya ba rab 'jug ma/ /de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gnyis med ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i ro snyoms shing*/ /bdag med ngo bo phyag rgya che/ /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /byang chub sems mchog rnam par dag /'gyur ba med pa'i rdo rje'i dbyings/ /mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /mchog sbyin ma ni bde ba che/ /mi zad rdo rje nor bu'i dbyings/ /bla na med pa'i dbang bskur ba/ /rin chen mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dri med chos ni rnam par dag /sku gsung thugs ni mtshan ma bral/ /dri med ye shes che brnyes pa/ /pad+ma mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rdo rje las ni thogs pa med/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug 'gro ba'i mgon/ /nan tan ye shes che brnyes pa/ /las kyi mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ / ces pa'o/ /bar 'dir sbyin bsregs dang*/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i mchod pas kyang mchod/ de nas gtor ma gnyis kho na bshams na/ /gtor chog ltar gtor ma 'bul/ brgyad bshams pa ltar na/ gtor ma dang po lnga 'jig rten 'das 'khor dang*/ drug pa a kā ro/ lan bcus phyogs skyong dang*/ bdun pa gtor chog ltar zhing skyong dang*/ brgyad pa gzhi bdag gtor ma ni kha 'bar ma'i sngags kyis btang ngo*/ /sgos kyi chos skyong yod na'ang skabs su gang bab tu bya'o/ /de nas bla ma gong ma rnams ni skabs 'dir dam tshig gsum gyi glu blangs bar bzhed de/ 'on kyang gzhung las ma bshad pas bsdu na med kyang chog go /bzhi pa ni/ slob ma la dbang bskur ba de tsam zhig bdag 'jug blang ngo*/ /gnyis pa slob ma dkyil 'khor du gzhug cing dbang bskur ba dngos ni/ yol ba'i phyi rol du sngon 'gro'i chos bshad/ slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/

/ zhes pa nas/ mthong bar shog gi bar bden stobs brjod/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ /slob dpon mgon la skyabs su mchi/ /gtso bo mkha' 'gro mar bcas pa'i/ /lha rnams kun la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol/ / lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ oṃ āḥhūṃ gis gdong bcing*/ slob dpon gyi lag gi rdo rje la 'jus te yol ba'i nang du bcug /gu gul gyis bdug /yungs dkar gyis brabs bzhin pas/ las thams cad pa'i sngags kyis bgegs bskrad/ bu khyod su yin dris pa la/ bdag skal ba bzang po can lags/ zhes lan gdab tu gzhug de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /he ru ka dpal grong khyer mchog /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni/ /bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bgyi/ / zhes dkyil 'khor la gsol ba gdab/ dkyil 'khor gyi sgo bzhi yid kyis phye bar mos/ slob mas gnas gsum du thal mo sbyor bzhin pas/ oṃ na ma ste hūṃ/ na mo mi hūṃ/ na mo na ma hūṃ swāhā/ zhes brjod pas phyag 'tshal ba sngon du btang la/ shar nas snying gar thal mo sbyor bzhin du/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī pū dza u pa s+thā na ya/ āt+ma naṃ nir+yā ta ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta/ a k+ṣo bh+yaḥ.a bhi ṣiñtsa/ a dhi tiṣ+ṭha swā maṃ/ zhes brjod du gzhug /de bzhin du badz+ra zhes pa'i gnas su/ rat+na dang*/ ak+ṣo bh+yaḥ zhes pa'i gnas su/ rat+na sam+bha wa bcug ste/ dpral bar thal mo sbyar la lho nas dang*/ de bzhin du/ pad+ma zhes dang*/ pad+ma dha ra zhes sbyar la nub nas dang*/ bi shwa zhes dang*/ a mo gha sad+dhi zhes sbyar bas byang nas phyag 'tshal/ de nas sta gon bzhin rgyun bshags byed du gzhug pa'am/ bsdu na ma byas kyang chog /las bum gyi chu cung zad blud la/ dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ /sdom pa rnams kyang bdag la stsol/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa/ /slob dpon chen po bdag la stsol/

/ lan gsum rjes bzlos bya/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song*/ /'di ni sangs rgyas rigs dag pa'i/ /sdom pa brtan por gyur pa'o/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya ni/ /blo chen khyod kyis bzung bar bya/ /byang chub sems gang de rdo rje/ /shes rab dril bu de bsgrags so/ /slob dpon khyod kyis bzung bya ste/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /'di ni rdo rje'i rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig sdom pa yin par bshad/ /rin chen rigs la rtag tu ni/ /nyin dang mtshan mo lan drug tu/ / zang zing mi 'jigs chos dang byams/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni ma lus bzung*/ /'di ni pad+ma'i rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba'o/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ / mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ / de nas slob mas/ sangs rgyas kun la phyag 'tshal lo/ /he ru ka dpal mkha' 'gror bcas/ /kun nas bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams= man chad spyi dang 'dra bas/ rigs lnga'i sdom pa bzung*/ de nas slob ma las thams cad pa'i bum chus bsangs/ ā khaṃ wī ra hūṃ/ gis me tog gi 'phreng ba gtad/ slob ma'i snying gar zla ba la gnas pa'i rdo rje oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta uta pa ta ya mi/ zhes brjod du gzhug /rdo rje snying gar reg ste/ su ra te sa ma ya staṃ/ bo dhi tsit+ta badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes thams cad rnal 'byor du sems bskyed/ ā khaṃ wī ra hūṃ/ zhes yol ba'i nang du bcug /de nas dam tshig bsgrag pa ni/ deng khyod dpal he ru ka dang mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi rigs su zhugs kyi ngas khyod la dpal he ru ka'i ye shes bskyed par bya ste/ ye shes gang gis khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang dpal he ru ka dang mkha' 'gro ma'i dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur na dngos grub gzhan lta ci smos/

khyod kyis dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i mdun du brjod par mi bya ste dam tshig nyams par gyur ta re/ rdo rje spyi bor bzhag ste/ 'di ni su yang rung ba la/ /gal te khyod kyis smras gyur na/ khyod kyi dam tshig rdo rje yis/ /rang gi mgo bo 'gas par 'gyur/ / rdo rje snying gar gtad la/ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi/ /snying la yang dag gzhugs par gyur/ /gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu dral te gshegs/ / bdud rtsi blud la/ oṃ badz+ra u da ka hūṃ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ni/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis grub/ /oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ to da ka hūṃ/ rdo rje spyi bor gtugs te/ deng nas brtsams te khyod kyi ni/ /he ru ka dpal nga yin gyis/ /nga yis bsgo ba khyod kyis gyis/ khyod kyis nga la brnyas byas na/ /mi bde ma spangs dus byas nas/ /dmyal bar lhung bar gyur ta re/ / slob mas ye shes dbab pa'i don du gsol ba gdab pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /bdag la byin gyis rlobs mdzod la/ /rdo rje ye shes bla med ni/ /da lta nyid du dbab du gsol/ / zhes lan gsum/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod blud la/ 'di skad ces/ khyed rang rnams he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ snying ga pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi'i steng du nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūṃ sngon po/ /oṃ āḥhrīḥhūṃ hūṃ zhes pa'i sngags kyis bskor ba/ mar me bzhin du 'od 'bar ba la ma yengs par rtse gcig tu sgom shig /mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas hūṃ sngon 'od 'phro ba/ de las 'od zer dkar po 'phreng ma chad pa byung ba snying gar zhugs/ lus thams cad 'od zer dkar pos gang bar mos/ zhes brjod la rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te/ oṃ āḥhrīḥhūṃ hūṃ oṃ badz+ra ā be sha ya a a/ zhes drag tu brjod cing*/

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bkug ste slob ma'i lus la bcug par bsgom/ gnyis pa spogs chog ni/ slob ma'i snying gar zla ba la gnas pa'i he ru ka yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas 'od zer dmar po'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung ste lus thams cad gang*/ mthar yab yum 'od zer dmar por zhu/ lus kyi nad thams cad 'od zer dmar pos gang bar sgoms shig ces brjod la rol mo'i sgra bya ba gong bzhin slob ma'i spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram bzhag ste/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ zhes brjod pas brtan par byas/ nam mkha'i kha dog 'bri/ lha'i rigs kyi rim pa dang*/ / bsod nams rim pa de bzhin shog /'di yi dngos grub ci 'drar 'gyur/ / rigs ni gang gi snod du 'gyur/ /'di la bsod nams ci yod pa/ /dkyil 'khor 'dir ni de bzhin shog / zhes slob dpon gyis bden stobs brjod/ bde gshegs snying po'i dkyil 'khor du/ /rig pa'i me tog 'di phul bas/ /sngon tshe ye shes bsnyen pa'i lha/ /gang yin de la 'bab par shog /oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra ho/ zhes brjod du gzhug cing me tog 'bul/ sems can stobs chen khyod kyis ni/ /'di ni rab tu gus pas bzung*/ zhes me tog slob ma'i mgo la bcings/ skabs 'dir me tog sbyin pa 'di mar rngog sogs gong ma'i phyag len yin/ gzhung don ni ma yin no/ / slob ma'i mig gnyis la yi ge oṃ/ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi/ /mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad/ /phye bas thams cad mthong ba yang*/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ /oṃ badz+ra nai tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa lam hrīḥ zhes gdong g.yogs phye/ de nas blta bar bskul ba ni/ dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ /da ni dad pa rab tu bskyed/ khyod na rnal 'byor ma rigs skyes/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ /'gro ba phun tshogs dngos grub kun/ /dngos grub thams cad mngon du 'gyur/ /dam tshig thams cad bskyang ba dang*/

/sngags rnams la yang brtson par gyis/ / zhes brjod la mngon rtogs ltar lha ngo ston/ bdag 'jug gi skabs su/ dkyil 'khor chen po mngon sum du mthong zhing byin gyis brlabs par gyur zhes brjod/de nas dbang bskur ba dngos la bzhi las/ dang po bum dbang bskur ba ni/ maṇ+ḍal phul/ he ru ka dpal dbang bskur ba/ /'gro ba skyobs phyir gzi brjid can/ /ji ltar yon tan 'byung gnas stsal/ /de bzhin bdag la deng stsol cig /dpa' bo chen po mi ldog pa'i/ /dbang bskur ba ni bdag la stsol/ / sems can kun kyi don bgyid phyir/ /bdag ni rtag tu slob dpon 'gyur/ / slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros dbang gi lha dpal he ru ka rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs dpag tu med pa dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ a r+ghaṃ dang nyer spyod phul/ rdo rje can gyi sangs rgyas la= nas/ gnang bar zhu zhes gsol ba gdab bo/ / slob ma dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su pad+ma 'dab brgyad khri dang bcas pa la bzhag pa'am bzhag par mos su bcug /yungs kar gyis brabs/ 'khyil ba'i sngags kyis bgegs bskrad/ hūṃ zhes bsrung ba bya/ steng du gdugs phub/ mtha' skor du mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung pos bskor bar mos/ slob ma mahā ma ya he ru ka'i sku gyur/ oṃ pra tīts+tsha hoḥ gtso bo la me tog dor/ oṃ dhar+m+ma kuṇ+ḍa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ me tog 'phreng ba slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag go /dbang dang po'o/ /bsangs sbyangs/ dbang rdzas bum chu mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las byung ba'i mi bskyod pa he ru ka /sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ rus pa'i rgyan can/ yum mā ma kī sngon po gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor bar gyur/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad mi bskyod pa'i rnam par badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ badz+ra dh+rika ces lan bdun bzlas/

mi bskyod pa zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chur gyur/ bum chu rnams gtso bo'i bum pa'am thod par bsdus la/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni/ khams gsum kun kyis phyag byas pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi/ /gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya/ /oṃ āḥhrīḥhūṃ hūṃ oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ zhes bum pa'i chus dbang bskur ba na/ mkha' 'gro ma bum pa thogs pa dpag tu med pas kyang dbang bskur bar gyur/ de ltar na chu dbang bskur bas kun gzhi rnam shes gnas gyur nas/ me long lta bu'i ye shes rgyud la skyes pa yin no/ / zhes rtogs pa bskyed/ bsangs sbyangs/ dbang rdzas cod pan= aṃ las rin chen 'byung ldan he ru ka ser po rin po che dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ rus pa'i rgyan can/ yum rin chen sgrol ma ser mo gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor bar gyur/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rnam par badz+ra sa mā dzaḥdzaḥ hūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ swa rat+na dhṛka ces lan bdun tsam bzlas la/

rin chen 'byung ldan zhu ba las byung ba'i cod pan du gyur/ thor tshugs cod pan gyis brgyan pa/ /sangs rgyas kun kyis bsngags pa yi/ /rin chen dag gi dbu rgyan dang*/ /dar dpyangs dbang bskur sbyin par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra pā ṭa ka a ral+li hūṃ/ oṃ rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ zhes dbu rgyan gyis dbang bskur ba na/ mkha' 'gro ma dpag tu med pas kyang cod pan gyis dbang bskur bar gyur/ de ltar dbu rgyan gyi dbang bskur bas nyon mongs pa can gyi yid gnas gyur nas/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes rgyud la skyes pa yin no/ / bsangs sbyangs/ dbang rdzas rdo rje= dz+riṃ las snang ba mtha' yas he ru ka dmar po pad+ma dang dril bu 'dzin pa rus pa'i rgyan can/ yum gos dkar mo dmar mo gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba= sogs dang*/ āḥ.a ro lika= ces bzla/ 'od dpag med= rdo rjer gyur/ slob ma'i lag pa g.yas par rdo rje gtad la/ oṃ sangs rgyas rdo rje'i dbang bskur bas/ / de ring khyod la dbang bskur bya/ /sangs rgyas kun tu rab grub phyir/ /rdo rje 'di ni khyod kyis bzung*/ oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti s+t+waṃ/ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje'i sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun du bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snyems tshul bdag po'i bdag / ces snying gar bzung du 'jug go / mkha' 'gro ma dpag tu med pas kyang dbang bskur/ de ltar na rdo rje'i dbang bskur bas/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa gnas gyur nas/ so sor kun tu rtog pa'i ye shes rgyud la skyes pa yin no/ / bsangs sbyangs/ dbang rdzas dril bu/ khaṃ las don yod grub pa he ru ka ljang khu ral gri dang dril bu 'dzin pa rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ yum dam tshig sgrol ma ljang khu gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor bar= ha pradzñā dhṛka= ces bzlas/ don yod grub pa dril bur= de nas dril bu lag pa g.yon du byin la/

'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad/ khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang*/ /byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzhed/ /srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems can gyis/ /mchog gi srid pa byed par 'gyur/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka a dhi pa ti staṃ/ a bhi ṣiñtsa tiṣ+ṭha bī ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ mkha' 'gro ma dpag tu med pas kyang dril bu'i dbang bskur/ de ltar na dril bu'i dbang bskur bas sgo lnga'i rnam shes gnas gyur nas bya ba sgrub pa'i ye shes rgyud la skyes pa yin no/ / slob ma mahā ma ya dpal he ru ka la yum sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro mas 'khyud par gyur/ shes rab bcu drug lon pa la/ /lag pa dag gis yang dag 'khyud/ /rdo rje dril bu mnyam sbyor ba/ /slob dpon gyi ni dbang du brjod/ /yid kyi lus su brtan pa'i phyir/ /phyag rgya'i dam tshig rab tu brjod/ /gang gi lus ni thams cad brtan/ /des na phyag rgya rab tu bsgrags/ / zhes phyag rgya sku'i dam tshig bzung ngo*/ / dbang rdzas rdo rje dang rdo rje dril bu mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+ruṃ las rnam snang dkar po 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa rus pa'i rgyan can/ yum spyan ma dkar mo gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor bar gyur/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros sangs rgyas thams cad rnam par snang mdzad kyi rnam par badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ dzi na dzig= ces mang du bzlas/ rnam snang zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rdo rje dang rdo rje dril bur gyur/ slob ma'i mgo bor rdo rje dang dril bu bzhag la/ oṃ shrī he ru ka a dhi pa ti staṃ/ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ shrī he ru ka nā ma a bhi ṣe ka ta kye dpal/ rigs dang mthun pa'i ming btags/ zhes ming gi dbang bskur ba na/ mkha' 'gro ma dpag tu med pas kyang ming gi dbang bskur/

de ltar ming gi dbang bskur bas/ phung po bzhi gnas gyur nas/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes mngon du gyur pa yin no/ / de nas dbang rdzas rnams bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ a las gri gug dang ḍā ma ru hūṃ las thod pa dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga rnams thabs dang shes rab zung 'jug gi rang bzhin du gyur/ he ru ka dpal kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /rnal 'byor ma ni ḍā ma ru/ /rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ rdo rjer bcas/ /dril bu sil sil sgra sgrog pa/ /tshangs pa'i skud thogs rnal 'byor bdag /gri gug dang ni ka pā la/ /dpa' bo chen pos blang bar gyis/ / 'di gzhung las ma bshad kyang bod kyi bla ma rnams mdzad pa mi 'brel ba ma yin no/ /slob ma'i snying ga'am lag tu rdo rje gtad cing*/ 'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /he ru ka dpal phyag na gnas/ khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang*/ /he ru ka dpal brtul zhugs brtan/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa s+t+waṃ dha ra ya mi hūṃ ha ha ha ha hiḥ zhes rdo rje brtul zhugs sbyin no/ / dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ dbang gi lha rnams slob ma la thim/ mchod pa brtan bzhugs bya'o/ /rgyud bsdus pa 'di dag la cho ga'ang bsdus pa shin tu 'os pas/ de tsam gyis kyang lugs 'di'i bum dbang ma tshang ba med pa yin la/ spros pa la dga' na 'di dag kyang bya bar bzhed de/ ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis/ /'jig rten rab rib bsal ba ltar/ /bu khyod kyi ni mi shes pa'i/ /rab rib rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal/ /oṃ badz+ra nai tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa laṃ hrīḥ zhes mig thur dang*/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /bzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun tu 'byung*/ / zhes brjod de me long dang*/ hoḥlas skyes pa'i mda' gzhu/ hoḥsarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ya swaḥ zhes mda' gzhu lag tu gtad de 'phen tshul byed du gzhug /rkang pa'i bar du 'khor lo btsug la/

de ring phyin chad 'jig rten la/ /skyobs pa rnams kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bla med pas/ /kun tu sdig med dri med pa'o/ / dung dang po ti gtad la/ khyod kyi the tshom dogs med par/ /yid gnyis med pa'i sems kyis su/ /chos kyi dung ni bla med pas/ /dri med kun tu gang bar byos/ /zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang dgug /sdang bar byed dang gnod sogs dang*/ /bsad dang bskrad pa thams cad de/ /las de rnams ni sgrub par gyis/ / zhes las sna tshogs dang*/ / nangs par sngar langs sems dag nyid/ /ma lus las ni byas nas kyang*/ /srung dang bza' ba la sogs pa/ /sdom pa'i bdag nyid can srung ngo*/ / zhes dam tshig sbyin no/ /bla gos gyon zhing skyabs sbyin dang bcas pas/ 'dir ni khyod la ngas lung bstan/ /he ru ka dpal de bzhin gshegs/ /srid pa shin tu bsgrub pas ni/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las bton/ /he shrī che ge mo na ma sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dha sa ma ya bhur bhuḥwa swa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis lung bstan par mos pa gyis shig /gsang chen mchog gi dkyil 'khor du/ /mthong ba dang ni bcag pa yis/ /sdig pa kun las rnam grol nas/ khyod ni de ring bde bar gnas/ /slob dpon brnyas par mi bya zhing*/ /gus pa yis ni mchod par byed/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang*/ /yongs su btang bar mi bya'o/ /dam tshig sdom pa bsrung bya ste/ /rnam par mi rtog gos med pas/ /rang lha'i rnal 'byor gnas pa yis/ /'dod pa'i yon tan bsten par bya/ khyod rang sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ / zhes dbugs dbyung ngo*/ /mig thur nas 'di'i bar bum dbang dang bzhi pa'i 'jug 'dam ka dang gsang dbang gi mthar yang rung bar bshad pas nub gcig la dbang ji tsam byed pa de'i mthar sbyor ro/ / de ltar na bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag /dman pa dbyibs kyi rnal 'byor sgoms pa dang*/ rgyud nyan bshad dang gtor ma'i bya ba la sogs pa la dbang ngo*/

/ gnyis pa gsang dbang ni/ rig ma mtshan ldan dang bcas pa'i zhing khams phul bar bsams la/ maṇ+ḍal phul/ khyod kyi zhabs kyi drin gyis ni/ /bdag gis bla med byang chub thob/ /gsang ba'i dbang bskur gsang ba che/ /gtso bo chen pos bdag la stsol/ / zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ oṃ āḥhūṃ mig dar bcing*/ mngon rtogs ltar/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma'i mgo bor oṃ dkar po zhes pa nas £¨¡¶dzaṃ¡·+ snying gar hūṃ sngon po/ lte bar swā ser po/ gsang gnas su āḥdamar po/ brla gnyis la ha ljang khu/ mkha' gsang stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ rdo rje oṃ las nor bu/ hrī las pad+ma bh+ruṃ las ze'u 'bru'o/ /'khyud pa tsum pa la sogs pas shes rab ma la bde ba skyes pa na/ lha mo bzhis/ e ma gnyen mchog rdo rje'i 'od kyis pad+ma rab phye shiga.a la la la la ho/ bde ba chen po rab tu dgyes pa'i gar mdzod cig /ji ltar nyi ma'i 'od kyis pad+ma rab kha 'byed pa bzhin/ a la la la la ho/ bde ba chen po rab tu dgyes pa'i gar mdzod cig / ces bskul bas/ 'dod pa'i sgyu rtsal dang bcas snyoms par zhugs pa'i sgra dang sbyor mtshams nas byung ba'i phaṭa yig gis sgras/ sangs rgyas thams cad bkug nas £© yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba a wa dhu tī'i lam brgyud rdo rje nas phyung ste/ shes rab kyi mkhar gnas pa'i byang chub kyi sems lce steng du babs par gyur/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni/ sogs kyi mthar 'bru gsum brjod la/ 'o ma dang bdud rtsi ril bu sbyar ba sbyin/ des kyang*/ a ti su khaṃ/ zhes brjod/ 'bru gsum gyis mig ras bsal lo/ / de ltar na gsang ba'i dbang thob pas ngag gi dri ma dag /steng sgo sngags kyi rnal 'byor sgom pa dang*/ bza' ba'i dam tshig bstan pa la dbang ba yin no/ / gsum pa shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ni/ slob mas maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ slob dpon go 'phang che rang bzhin/ /skal pa chen po bdag la stsol/

/bde gshegs rnams kyi dbang bskur ni/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rab sgrub pa/ /brtul zhugs mchog gi khyod drin gyis/ /bdag la nges par stsal nas kyang*/ /des ni sems can dpag med don/ /ji ltar 'dul bzhin bdag bgyid do/ / zhes lan gsum gsol ba gdab/ /'bru gsum gyis mig dar bcings/ de nas slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas/ rig ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma mdzes sgeg lang tsho dang ldan par byin gyis rlabs te/ khyed rang rnams he ru kar gsal ba la 'khyud par mos/ mdzes ma 'di ni bzung ba dang*/ /bsten byar sangs rgyas kun gy-is bsngags/ /'di ni gzungs ma yid dga' ma/ khyod kyis rtag tu brjod par gyis/ /rang snang ba'i lha sku yab yum mnyam par sbyar ba'i rkyen gyis/ lte ba'i gtum mo ye shes kyi me a thung drod kyi rang bzhin can 'bar ba la mnyam par bzhag pas/ spyi bo'i thig le zhu ba'i dga' ba bzhi rgyud la skyes par gyur/ 'bru gsum gyis mig dar dbye'o/ / de ltar na shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob pas/ yid kyi dri ma dag / 'og sgo sngags kyi rnal 'byor sgom pa la dbang ba yin no/ /bzhi pa tshig dbang rin po che ni/ maṇ+ḍal zhig phul la/ mtshon bya don bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes shes bya gshis kyi dngos po'i gnas lugs de nyid mtshon byed dpe dbang gsum pa'i dus su nyams myong gi sgo nas gtan la phab pas de'i rang bzhin gdod ma nas 'od gsal bde chen rnam pa thams cad pa yin te/ rgyud las/ chos rnams rang bzhin 'od gsal ba/ /gdod nas dag cing rnyog pa med/ /thabs brjod de yis de la ni/ /rang byung ye shes lnga ldan 'gyur/ / zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /zhes mtshams sbyar nas gnas lugs la cung zad 'jog tu gzhug de ltar na dbang bzhi pa thob pas lus ngag yid gsum tha dad du 'dzin pa dag / mthar thug chos kyi rnal 'byor sgom pa la dbang ngo*/

/gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal sogs/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ deng nas brtsams te sogs spyi dang 'dra'o/ /dbang bzhi nyin zhag so so la bskur na/ gsang ba dang*/ shes rab kyi dbang la yang spyod pa'i dbang ma gtogs/ chu nas brtul zhugs kyi bar bum dbang ltar phal cher sngon du 'gro bar byed la/ khyad par ni phyag rgya'i dam tshig brtul zhugs kyi rjes su byed pa'o/ /rtsa ba'i sa bcad gsum pa rjes kyi cho ga la mchod pa byin rlabs dang 'bul tshul sa chog gi skabs su bshad pa dang 'dra/ de nyid lnga pas bstod/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs bzod gsol nas bkra shis kyi bar sta gon gyi skabs bzhin/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ / sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ āḥhūṃ badz+ra muḥ zhes lan gsum gyis ye shes pa gshegs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ lan bdun gyis dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ a kā ro 'i sngags kyis rdul tshon phyags shing*/ dri bzang gi chu thig rnams dbyi/ rdul tshon chu bor spyan drangs la/ dkyil 'khor gyi shul du zhi ba'i sbyin bsreg bya/ sngar dngos su phur gdab byas na phur pa'ang dbyung dgos so/ /rgyud rgyal sgyu 'phrul chen mo yi/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga rab gsal bar/ / bris pa'i dge ba gang yin des/ /'gro kun he ru kar gyur cig/ //mahā ma ya'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rin chen sgron ma zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rdo rje 'dzin pa byams pa ngag dbang kun dga' zhes bya ba'i gsung gis bskul nas/ rgyal khams pa twa ra nā thas sbyar ba ste/ yang smras pa/ rgya gzhung rnams ni go dka' ste/ /'ga' zhig brgyud pa'ang chad pa dang*/ /lugs 'dir mkhas shing grub brnyes pa/ /phyogs 'dir byon pas sbyar ba yang*/ /cung zad brjod pa mi bde zhing*/ /mkhas pa 'ga' zhig gis sbyar ba/ /dpe sna sna tshogs bsdus pa'i phyir/ /snying po byin rlabs rgyun chad dang*/ /man ngag ldan pa'i yi ge ni/ /gsal po gzhan yang ma mthong bas/ /gzhung dang man ngag ji bzhin du/

/cung zad 'bad rtsol byas pa yin/ /mahā ma ya la dkyil chog rgya gzhung bzhi yod de/ dkyil chog rim pa gsal ba lo tsā ba gzhon nu tshul khrims kyi 'gyur/ 'di'i dpe rnying mang po la mdzad byang med/ kha cig las ku ku ri pas mdzad/ ces 'byung*/ mar rngog kyang de ltar bzhed/ don la'ang ku ku ri pa'i gsung dngos sam gsung gi rgyun ma nor pa yin par nges la/ kha cig las nag po spyod pas mdzad ces 'byung na chog sgros rnams sdom pa'i dkyil chog dang mthun shas che ba bsams pa'o/ /gzhan dpal brgyan pas mdzad pa dang*/ 'dul bas byin gyis mdzad pa'i dkyil chog yod/ ku ku ri pa nyid kyis mdzad zer ba'i dbang chog 'gos 'gyur zhig yod de/ ku ku ri pa'i rtsom min par nges so/ /rgya gar gyi sgrub dkyil gyi rigs la/ rgyal po dhar+m+ma pā la yan chad la brtsams pa dang*/ de rjes sgo drug gi bar dang*/ de nas a bha ya'i bar dang*/ de'i phyis su byung ba ste/ dus thog bzhi po de'i skabs kyi bstan bcos rnams la rtsoms kyi babs byed lugs mi 'dra ba re snang ba de go na/ rim pa gsal ba 'di dang po'i rigs su 'dug /gzhan 'di rnams gsum pa'i rigs su 'dug pas/ mahā ma ya'i dkyil chog rtsa ba de rim pa 'dir 'dug /nyan bshad kyi bka' yang 'di la yod pas byin rlabs kyi rgyun can yin/ 'dir brgyud pa gong ma'i phyag len kha skongs rnams man ngag ltar byas dgyes rdor sogs kyi 'dres byas pa 'di'i gzhung dang mi mthun pa rnams dor te/ gtsang dag tu sbyar ba'o//
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/dpal mahā mā ya'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rin chen sgron me zhes bya ba bzhugs/ - PAGE 34 -- PAGE 35 -- PAGE 12 -
